candidates.source_name: BQK/CBK — Time Series database (Seritë Kohore)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical machine-readable long-run series compiled by the sole legally mandated compiler of monetary/financial statistics for Kosovo. Organised by category (Central Bank, ODCs/commercial banks, other financial corporations, pension funds, insurance, financial auxiliaries, external sector) with balance-sheet items, deposits, loans, interest rates, exchange rates. This is the spine of A4 for XK.
candidates.access_status: public, but HTML pages sit behind a Cloudflare interstitial for automated clients
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector statistics published under the Law on the CBK; re-use normally permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless browser (Playwright) session to pass the Cloudflare challenge, then harvest the linked XLSX/PDF files; direct file URLs under /wp-content/uploads/ and /repository/docs/ appear to serve fine to a plain HTTPS client with a normal User-Agent. Respect robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search + snowball from CBK statistics landing page
queries_used: BQK statistika seria kohore buletini mujor statistikor Banka Qendrore e Republikës së Kosovës
Central Bank of Kosovo time series statistics monthly statistical bulletin bqk-kos.org

candidates.source_name: BQK/CBK — Monthly Statistics Bulletin (Buletini Mujor Statistikor / BMS)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly flagship statistical release since 2001 (issue numbering in the 250s-280s as of 2024-2025). Covers financial, external, fiscal and real sector, and — critically for A4 — includes payment-system data alongside deposits, loans, interest rates and exchange rates. Highest-frequency canonical series for XK.
candidates.access_status: public; PDF endpoints returned HTTP 200 to a plain client, landing pages Cloudflare-challenged
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate issue-number pattern in the upload path and fetch PDFs directly (observed patterns CBK_MSB_<n>_en.pdf and CBK_BMS_<n>_Sq.pdf); parse the payment-system and monetary tables. Monthly cadence.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search + verified content-type/HTTP-200 on PDF endpoints

candidates.why_relevant: Serbian-language edition of the same mandated monthly bulletin; resolves the sr language requirement for the A4 cell and provides Serbian statistical terminology for downstream matching. Historic issues (e.g. br. 53, 2006) are archived, giving deep back-series.

candidates.source_name: BQK/CBK — Financial Stability Report (Raporti i Stabilitetit Financiar)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual analytical report with the richest narrative + tabular view of banking-sector structure, credit growth, NPLs, capitalisation, liquidity, and increasingly payment/digitalisation indicators. Report No. 21 (2025 edition) reports EUR 14.6bn financial-system assets, EUR 6.7bn loans (+14.7% y/y), NPL ~2%. Ideal for sizing and trend context.
candidates.legal_status: official publication, free re-use with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF fetch by incrementing the report number (BQK_FSR_<n>.pdf); table extraction from statistical annex.

candidates.why_relevant: Annual institutional report whose payment-system chapter carries the authoritative national interbank payment system (SPN/KIPS) volumes and values — e.g. the 2022 edition reports 17.4m SPN transactions, +19.2% volume / +18.6% value. candidates.why_relevant: The single most on-point document for the card/ATM/POS topics of this cell: dedicated CBK payment-systems analysis of card usage, with ATM vs POS transaction split and growth rates (e.g. domestic POS card payments +30.67% in 2023; POS transactions overtaking ATM as debit cards displace cash for small-value payments). negative_findings.description: Every HTML route on bqk-kos.org tested (statistikat/serite-kohore, statistikat/, sitemap.xml, wp-sitemap.xml) returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge, both via WebFetch and via curl with a realistic desktop User-Agent.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTML pages not retrievable by simple HTTP clients; this is bot mitigation, NOT evidence the pages are dead. robots.txt itself returned HTTP 200 and permits general crawling (only /wp-admin/, /wp-includes/, plugins, themes, /tmp/, /private/ disallowed) with Crawl-delay: 10, so the site policy invites crawling even though the WAF blocks naive clients.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection pipeline for this cell must budget for a headless-browser fetcher for CBK HTML pages. Treat all CBK HTML URLs in this slice as unverified-but-probably-live.

negative_findings.description: Static file endpoints on the same domain are NOT challenged: HEAD requests to /repository/docs/SistemiIPagesave/Perdorimi%20i%20kartelave%20ne%20Kosove.pdf and /wp-content/uploads/2024/11/CBK_MSB_251_en.pdf both returned HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf (690 KB and 7.46 MB respectively).
negative_findings.result_summary: PDF/asset harvesting works with an ordinary HTTPS client; only link discovery needs a browser.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two-stage collection is viable and cheap: browser-based discovery of links, plain-HTTP bulk download of the documents themselves.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, separately-navigable 'payment system statistics' dataset page with downloadable card/ATM/POS time series could be confirmed. Searches surfaced only (a) the thematic PDF 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë', (b) references stating that payment-system data sits inside the Monthly Statistical Bulletin, and (c) a legacy aggregate route (?id=125) described as holding 'publikime statistikore, analiza dhe materiale tjera informative nga Sistemi i Pagesave'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card/ATM/POS series appear to be embedded in the bulletin and the annual report rather than exposed as a standalone dataset.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A4 card/ATM/POS extraction for XK will likely require table extraction from bulletin PDFs rather than downloading a ready-made series — plan parsing effort accordingly.

negative_findings.description: No open API, SDMX endpoint, or bulk-download interface was found for the CBK time series; all evidence points to per-table XLSX/PDF downloads only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No programmatic statistical API identified for BQK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out API-based ingestion; the collector must be file-based with change detection.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language coverage of the specifically payments/card/ATM/POS material was thin. Serbian searching resolved the institutional and macro layer (Mesečni Statistički Bilten, Odeljenje za statistiku, CBK_VTE quarterly, finansijska stabilnost pages) but returned no Serbian equivalent of 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë'.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr coverage exists for core statistics and macro reports but was not confirmed for the payments-thematic publications.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If sr-language payments material matters to the consumer of this research, it may need to be requested from the CBK directly or reconstructed from the sr bulletin; do not assume trilingual parity for every document.

negative_findings.description: The CBK site has migrated at least twice: legacy query-string routes (index.php?id=47, ?id=57, ?id=125), a legacy /repository/docs/ file tree, and a current WordPress structure (/statistikat/, /publikimet/, /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/) all coexist, with both www and non-www hostnames in circulation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple parallel URL generations serve live content simultaneously.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Link-rot risk is real and a single 404 must not be read as a dead source. A crawler for this cell should try the legacy route family and both hostnames before declaring anything gone, and should keep a URL-alias map.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact contents of the Time Series database (which tables exist, at what frequency, whether any payment-instrument tables are included, and file formats) could not be enumerated because the page is Cloudflare-protected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one headless-browser pass over https://bqk-kos.org/statistikat/serite-kohore/ in sq, en and sr, capture the full link inventory, and store it as the authoritative table catalogue for XK A4.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash usage in the narrow sense (currency in circulation / cash withdrawals as a share of transactions) is only weakly covered. Kosovo unilaterally uses the euro and does not issue currency, so there is no domestic currency-in-circulation series; cash intensity must be proxied via ATM withdrawal volumes and the cash-vs-card split in CBK payment data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define cash-usage proxies explicitly for XK (ATM withdrawal count/value from the bulletin, POS-vs-ATM ratio from the card-usage report) and document that a currency-issuance series does not exist for this jurisdiction.

coverage_gaps.description: No per-bank or per-scheme (Visa/Mastercard) breakdown of card, ATM or POS activity was found in CBK output; published data appears sector-aggregated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cover the competitive/per-institution layer from adjacent cells — individual bank annual reports and the Kosovo Banking Association — rather than expecting it from the CBK.

coverage_gaps.description: No release calendar for CBK statistics was located, so publication timing must currently be inferred from observed file dates and news items.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Look for an advance release calendar (kalendari i publikimeve) on the statistics section during the headless-browser pass; if absent, drive collection from the /news/ feed as a change-detection trigger.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell deliberately stops at the CBK. Adjacent statistical compilers that would triangulate CBK figures — the Kosovo Agency of Statistics (ASK / Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës), the World Bank Global Findex and Kosovo's national payments infrastructure operator — were seen only in passing and are not documented here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure ASK, World Bank/Findex and the interbank payment-system operator (SPN/KIPS) are assigned to other coverage cells so the A4 XK picture is not CBK-only.

brief: The Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK / CBK / Centralna banka Republike Kosovo) is a genuinely single-point canonical source for XK A4: by law it compiles monetary, financial and external-sector statistics, and it publishes them through a small, stable and trilingual (sq/sr/en) set of channels — the Time Series database, the Monthly Statistics Bulletin (issue-numbered, running since 2001 and now in the 280s), the monthly financial-system information report, the quarterly macro assessment, the annual Financial Stability Report, and the Annual Report whose payment-system chapter carries national SPN volumes. Card, ATM and POS data — the core of this cell's payments topics — are not exposed as a standalone dataset; they live inside the bulletin and annual report tables plus one dedicated thematic publication, 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë', which is the single richest card/ATM/POS document found. Collection has one concrete technical constraint: every HTML route on bqk-kos.org sits behind a Cloudflare challenge (all HTML fetches 403'd), while PDF and other static files served cleanly at HTTP 200, so a two-stage pipeline — headless-browser link discovery, plain-HTTP bulk file download, respecting the robots.txt Crawl-delay of 10 — is the right design. Downstream re-publishers (IMF Financial Access Survey for comparable ATM/POS density, IMF staff and technical-assistance reports for both annex tables and an independent verdict on CBK data quality) should be used to benchmark and validate, never to replace, the CBK primary.
